page_title: ELC 3-2 ATM | Elche v Atletico Madrid 22/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Although Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) is just on the bench, Guillermo Cuadra has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
90+1' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90+1' Wonderful movement by Elche. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
89' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
88' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

88' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the left side of the goal, but Matias Dituro made an astonishing save!
86' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the left post.
84' The corner from Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is hurriedly cleared.

83' The ball is cleared after Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes behind for a corner. Atl. Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
83' We are about to witness a substitution. Pedro Bigas (Elche) is replacing Leo Petrot.
82' Andre Silva (Elche) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
81' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Giuliano Simeone, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
80' German Valera (Elche) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
75' 3 - 2 Goal Andre Silva (Elche)! Andre Silva (Elche) was put through by David Affengruber and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the right side of the net. 3:2.
75' Lucas Cepeda (Elche) takes a short corner kick.
74' German Valera (Elche) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. Elche will have a chance to score from a corner.
73' Andre Silva (Elche) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Jan Oblak blocks the shot with his legs.
71' A rebound bounces out to Aleix Febas (Elche) on the edge of the box, but he can't control his shot and it slips well wide of the right post.
71' Josan (Elche) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
71' German Valera (Elche) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Elche.
69' Lucas Cepeda (Elche) gets on the end of a pass and takes a low shot from the edge of the box which is straight at Jan Oblak, who makes a comfortable save.
67' The substitution has been made. Lucas Cepeda (Elche) has replaced Martim Neto.
67' Eder Sarabia has decided to make a change. Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) replaces Rafa Mir.
67' Tete Morente goes off the pitch and Josan (Elche) comes on.
66' Tete Morente (Elche) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
64' Tete Morente (Elche) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
64' Martim Neto (Elche) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play. Elche win a corner kick.
62' Substitution. Alex Baena did his best and is replaced by Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid).
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is coming onto the pitch as Rodrigo Mendoza cannot continue after picking up an injury.
62' Today's match ends for Obed Vargas who will be replaced by Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid).
60' Here is a change. Buba Sangare is going off and Eder Sarabia gives the last tactical orders to Victor Chust (Elche).
60' Martim Neto (Elche) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

60' Tete Morente (Elche) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Elche force a corner. They send men into the box.
60' Elche work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
59' Buba Sangare (Elche) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Elche will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
56' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Tete Morente (Elche) but poses no threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
53' Rafa Mir (Elche) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
51' Aleix Febas (Elche) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.

50' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Elche are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
49' The attendance for today's match is 27587.
47' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
46' Half-time substitution. Julio Diaz will not participate anymore and Marc Pubill (Atl. Madrid) is coming on.
46' Diego Simeone has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) comes on the pitch for Robin Le Normand.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+7' Guillermo Cuadra has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
45+4' Guillermo Cuadra shows a yellow card to Buba Sangare (Elche) for his blatant foul.
45+4' Aleix Febas (Elche) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
45+4' Martim Neto (Elche) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
45+3' Tete Morente (Elche) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The linesman points to the corner flag, Elche are going to take it.
45' 6 additional min. will be played.
42' Elche quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
42' German Valera (Elche) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Elche force their opponents to concede a corner.
38' Julio Diaz (Atl. Madrid) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
36' Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!

34' 2 - 2 Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) displays great tekkers inside the box leading to a fantastic goal, leaving the goalkeeper stranded. Referee Guillermo Cuadra points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Atl. Madrid players celebrate.
34' It’s in! Goal for Atl. Madrid, but surely the ball went out of play in the lead up. Referee Guillermo Cuadra wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
33' 2 - 1 Goal! Andre Silva (Elche) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Jan Oblak into the bottom left corner.
32' Andre Silva (Elche) is going to take the penalty!
30' Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid) makes an ugly challenge on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!

30' Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. Elche are awarded a penalty. What an opportunity to score!
29' Rodrigo Mendoza (Atl. Madrid) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Guillermo Cuadra signals.
28' Buba Sangare (Elche) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
27' Tete Morente (Elche) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Elche.
25' German Valera (Elche) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.

25' David Affengruber (Elche) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. Corner kick. Elche will have an opportunity.
23' A lofted cross from Buba Sangare (Elche) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
18' 1 - 1 GOAL! Tete Morente meets a cross inside the box and heads the ball across the goal, where David Affengruber (Elche) lurks and pokes it into the back of the net. 1:1.
18' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Elche.

17' Rafa Mir (Elche) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Elche.
17' Martim Neto (Elche) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
17' Elche take a short corner kick.

16' Gonzalo Villar (Elche) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. The referee blows his whistle, Elche are awarded a corner kick.
15' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
12' Buba Sangare (Elche) jumps into a tackle and Guillermo Cuadra signals a foul.

10' 0 - 1 Goal! Rodrigo Mendoza shows great vision to find Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the middle of the goal. 0:1.
9' Gonzalo Villar (Elche) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
8' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well wide of the right post.
5' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
4' Rafa Mir (Elche) peels away from his marker to receive a lofted pass, but sends his rocket of a shot just over the bar from inside the box.
2' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul after Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid) hacks down one of his opponents. There is a free kick near the sideline to Elche.
1' The resulting set piece from Elche is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The match will be delayed.
Atl. Madrid will kick the game off.
Guillermo Cuadra is introduced as the referee for today's match.
